event_chain.summary: Ransomware-precursor malware in OT weather systems

summary: In September 2026 South Africa's state-owned air traffic control operator ATNS found suspicious activity and malware commonly associated with the early stages of ransomware attacks in operational technology environments supporting weather services, with preliminary signs of data exfiltration to IP addresses in China. Facilities under investigation included Port Elizabeth and possibly East London airports and Maputo International Airport in Mozambique. ATNS believed its team had contained the attack and brought in forensics firms, which were also looking into possible insider data theft.
